gp.message:
================================================================================
AFTER EFFECTS TÂNA FLEX GUI PRO - ENG NGE A THAR
Version 9.2.8  -  October 2026
================================================================================

Panel hian tawng 132 a hmang thei tawh a, DEMON SLAYER THEME thar a lo awm a, i button hmet chu khandaih-in
a tem thin a, layout leh Windows fix ṭhenkhat a awm bawk.

INTAN HMAIN
- I ZXP installer hman ṭhin hmangin i version tûn lai chungah install la, tichuan
  After Effects hi vawi khat restart rawh.
- I settings, theme, preset leh save expression-te chu a awm reng ang.

A THAR: PANEL HI TAWNG 132-AH
- Flex Settings > TAWNG-ah tawng 132 a lang tawh a, search box pawh a awm. Pakhat thlang la,
  panel zawng zawng a danglam ang: tab, button, tooltip leh message-te.
- Tawng tin hi English panel atangin AI hmangin lehlin a ni a, thumal hrang hrangin lehlin ni lovin. I project-a
  i hmuh hming te (layer hming, effect hming) chu English-in a awm reng ang, chutiang chuan After Effects
  nen a inmil reng ang.
- "A thar" popup pawh he release atanga ṭan chuan lehlin a ni ang.

A THAR: DEMON SLAYER THEME
- Flex Settings > THEME THLANNA-ah DEMON SLAYER group thar a awm a, theme 11 a nei:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen leh Kokushibo.
- Mouse chu panel chungah sawn la, theme element chuan a zui ang: tui,
  mei, kaikuang, chengpereng, par hnah, chhum leh a dang tam tak. Mouse a ding chuan
  a bo mawlh ang.
- Button pakhat i click chuan character khandaih-in a tem ang. Left button i vawn reng chuan
  a tem zel ang; second 2.5 vel i vawn chuan a puak ang.
- Rit lo tûra siam a ni: effect te chu mouse i sawn emaw i click chhung chauhin an kal a, computer
  chak lo deuh-ah chuan mahni-in an rit lo thei bawk. Rawng chauh vawn nan Theme Thlanna-a
  AMBIENT EFFECT te chu off rawh.

DANGLAM: THEME TIN-A FLAT BUTTON
- Colour theme-a active leh button pui te chuan chunglam atanga hnuaiah shaded gradient an hmang tawh lo.
  Flat colour pakhat leh glow ngawi nen an ni a, chuvangin an hmel a ṭha deuh a,
  chhiar a awlsam deuh bawk.

SIAM ṬHAT NIH
- License card leh "a thar" popup te hi an inchungah an inhawng thei a ni. Tun atang chuan
  an inchungah an inhawng tawh lo vang, tin, UPDATE badge hian panel chunga button
  te a khuh tawh lo.
- UI SCALE 125% leh 150%-ah window ṭhenkhat (Flex Settings ang) hi panel aiin a sang zawk thei a,
  chuvangin an khar button chu hmuh theih loh a ni thin. Tunah chuan
  window tin hi size tinah a fit tawh.
- Windows: AutoCaptions hian card leh driver thar (RTX 40 leh 50 series) ah "NVIDIA DRIVER HI GPU
  CAPTION TÂN CHUAN A HLUI LUTUK" tih a ti thei. Tunah chuan driver CUDA support chu
  dik takin a chhiar a, i GPU a hmang tawh.

DANGLAM LOH
- Licensing, activation leh link tin chu a hmasa angin an thawk reng.
- Tab dang leh tool dang zawng zawng chu 9.2.7-a ang tak hian an thawk.
================================================================================

ult.message:
PREMIERE PRO TÂNA FLEX ULTIMATE - ENG NGE A THAR
Version 2.2.8  -  October 2026

CAPTION STACK caption te hi Motion Graphics template EDIT THEIH a ni tawh a, editor dik tak nen, AUDIO STUDIO
thar leh MARK AUDIO BEATS a awm a, panel hian tawng 132 a hmang a, UI SCALE hi ULTIMATE-ah a lo thleng a,
DEMON SLAYER THEME thar a awm bawk.

INTAN HMAIN
- I ZXP installer hman ṭhin hmangin i version tûn lai chungah install la, tichuan
  Premiere Pro hi vawi khat restart rawh.
- I settings, theme leh preset-te chu a awm reng ang.

A THAR: CAPTION STACK - CAPTION EDIT THEIH (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Caption te hi Motion Graphics template edit theih angin a dah tawh a (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, Premiere Pro 2026-a default thar). A dah zawh hnuah, Premiere-a
  Essential Graphics panel-ah thumal, font, colour, size, position, glow, outline, box,
  animation emaw timing emaw i duh angin i thlak thei.
- Output > IMAGES hian thumal tin chu a hmel hmasa ang tak nen milem angin a dah zel,
  i duh chuan.
- Template te hi panel nen a lo kal a. Download tur a awm lo.

A THAR: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview-ah hian caption tin hnuaiah i video frame dik tak a lang tawh.
- Caption pakhat drag la a sawn thei a, kil hmangin size thlak la, chunglam dot hmangin
  hum la, thumal pakhat double-click la edit thei. CAPTION ZAWNG ZAWNG hian thumal zawng zawng
  a sawn khawm a, THUMAL PAKHAT hian thumal pakhat chauh a sawn.
- Danglamna chu caption zawng zawng tan emaw he caption tan chauh emaw i thlang thei a, i layout te
  hman nawn nan i save thei bawk.
- GLOW look thar 10: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow leh Superb.

A THAR: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Audio clip thlang la, effect thlang la, APPLY hmet rawh. Engkim hi i computer-ah a
  thawk.
- Click khat preset 30: Tui hnuai, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse leh a dang tam tak. Effect i duh
  zat stack la, an order thlak la, emaw pakhat off rawh.
- Reverb hian a tail a vawng: ri chu clip tâwp hnuah pawh a ri zel a, tin, i timeline-a eng pawh
  overwrite a lo nih loh nan a dah a ni.
- Tool te: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  leh Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER hian hla pakhat chu vocal leh music (emaw stem 4) -ah a then. A vawi khatna
  chuan a model chu a download a, i zawt hmasa bawk.
- PREVIEW hian Original / Processed switch nen second 8 vel i ngaithla thei.
  A result chu audio track ruak-ah a kal a, i original clip chu mute a ni a,
  a delete reng reng lo.

A THAR: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Timeline-a music clip thlang la MARK BEATS hmet rawh: Flex hian beat te a hmu a,
  an chungah sequence marker a belh a, chutiang chuan i cut te chu
  music nen a inmil tak tak ang.
- Hit ZAWNG ZAWNG, KICKS emaw SNARES emaw thlang la, sensitivity set la, beat tin emaw
  beat pahnihna tin emaw palina tin emaw mark rawh.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS hian Flex-a belh marker chauh a paih. I computer-ah a
  thawk.

  lehlin a ni ang.

A THAR: UI SCALE
- Settings > UI SCALE hian panel hi a lian zawk emaw a tlem zawk emaw a tihtheih, Flex GUI Pro-a ang bawkin.
  Window tin hi size tinah a fit.

A THAR: DEMON SLAYER THEME
